schema_version: 1
name: ms-go-course
kind: go_backend_service
purpose: Own authored course catalog, hierarchy, lesson material, task definitions, assessments, runtime metadata, and content lifecycle events.
owns:
  - catalog tracks, levels, course groups, positions, technologies, versions, tags, and i18n references
  - reusable courses, modules, sections, lessons, examples, semantic relations, and ordered placements
  - task definitions, opaque learning-target references, task capabilities, validation contracts, structured assessments, compose configuration, and starter-file bindings
  - deprecated offline knowledge-task manifest compatibility and source-key identity for existing managed content only
  - canonical persistence and fingerprint reuse for fully generated Learning Planner courses
  - bounded 16 MiB generated Course document ingestion
  - atomic persistence and reuse of lazy one-lesson practice materials generated by Learning Planner
does_not_own:
  - student answers, attempts, reviews, and progress
  - validator execution or sandbox lifecycle
  - FileStorage object lifecycle outside task starter-file binding
stack: [Go, chi, pgx, PostgreSQL, NATS JetStream, Python import tooling]
entrypoint: cmd/mc-course-service/main.go
dependencies:
  postgres: required
  nats: optional at startup; publishing becomes a no-op if connection is unavailable
  ms-go-student: internal task progress lookup
  ms-go-filestorage: starter archive upload and activation
  ms-go-learning-planner: idempotent Course planning producer
trust_boundaries:
  admin: X-User-ID and X-User-Role are trusted from an upstream gateway and are not verified here
  public: guest access is allowed, with audience-aware content filtering
  internal: X-Internal-Token shared secret; route group is disabled only when configured token is empty
risks:
  - INTERNAL_API_TOKEN and TASK_ANSWER_SERVICE_INTERNAL_TOKEN default to change-me
  - generated Course creation is disabled until a distinct LEARNING_PLANNER_INTERNAL_TOKEN is configured
  - diagnostic catalog discovery is disabled until a distinct DIAGNOSTIC_CATALOG_INTERNAL_TOKEN is configured
  - NATS connection errors are ignored and lifecycle publish errors are discarded by use cases
  - migrate-fresh is valid only for a new empty Course database; existing databases require a reviewed forward migration plan
  - migrate-down drops and recreates the complete public schema
  - auth headers are spoofable when this service is exposed without a trusted gateway
